name: 苏飞

exactCharacter.y: 原为荆州牧刘表的部将，任江夏都督。苏飞与甘宁交好，但是数次向黄祖推荐都失败。甘宁决定投效孙权时助其逃离。后来甘宁率吴军攻破江夏，苏飞兵败被俘。孙权打算将苏飞处斩，但是因为甘宁用性命担保而赦免了苏飞。降吴后官至军都督。
exactCharacter.z: 与沮授一样需要合理安排出牌顺序以发挥技能的最强效果。
exactCharacter.x: 大胜归来，####找兴霸兄好好喝一杯！

versionIsolation: Current ordinary OL 858 LianPianSP matches retained official page and API. No other product or revision text is merged.
No exact character-specific official FAQ was verified. The sequence and paid continuation policies below are explicit implementation interpretations.
implementationInterpretations: Sequence consists of consecutive actual native Use actions by this actual Play actor; responses and other actors’ forced uses do not become that actor’s next Use. Actor and provider remain separate original native values.
Each actual Play instance has its own consecutive sequence. The optional activation quota is three for the whole actual turn, so an inserted Play cannot refresh it.

Only genuine finalized native primary targets count. Native implicit self targets participate. BorrowedSword retains complete ordered primary/victim pairs but only each primary is independently designated for intersection.

A native use with no common target replaces the last-use ledger. The owning CardUseFrame marks its accepted finalized issuance once, including zero-material uses with a real native Action; a repeated cursor cannot reopen an earlier native use.

One real native draw pays first. Its exact drawn entity may be gifted only if it remains in the owner hand after its native gain children. Another hand card cannot substitute. A common target equal to owner simply leaves the entity in that same hand, without a fabricated self-transfer.
The already-paid draw/gift program survives source loss with its exact immutable source/hash/native-use/window invoice. A dead owner drains issued children once and receives no new optional gift.

Public draw/gift payment facts contain only movement bounds/count and recipient, never the new private entity ID. The exact drawn card ID stays on the trusted owning receipt and is checked against genuine native movements; viewer-private choices expose it only to the owner.

A common recipient’s later death does not erase already-established consecutive designation. A higher-priority finalized observer may kill that target; Lianpian still draws once, and only the subsequent gift requires a living recipient.

BorrowedSword primary extraction uses the real Action.TargetSeats complete ordered pairs. Some red-additional single-card conversion producers already store primary-only DesignatedTargetSeats, so that compressed list must never be indexed as pairs again.

The retained native DrawTwo implicit-self shape normalizes Action.TargetSeats to actor but keeps an explicit empty DesignatedTargetSeats list. Only this exact DrawTwo shape falls back to its actual self target in the new SuFei helper; no historical global normalization changes.
